meta.title: Base-rate neglect
meta.lede: Kahneman’s cab problem, composed only from library modules: a ladder of parts, a prediction you commit to, a wrong model that runs first, a count that corrects it, two cities side by side, and one question to bring it back.
meta.synthesis: The witness’s 80 % is the chance she names a colour correctly, not the chance the cab is Blue. Count every cab she would call Blue — 120 Blue and 170 Green — and the Blue ones are 41 % of them. The base rate picks the denominator; ignoring it means answering as if the city were half Blue.
sources: Kahneman, Thinking, Fast and Slow, ch. 16 (Causes Trump Statistics) — the cab problem; the most common answer is 80 %, the correct answer 41 %
Tversky & Kahneman 1982 — Evidential impact of base rates
Gigerenzer & Hoffrage 1995 — natural frequencies make Bayes countable

captions.in.r.queue: The same city, one dot per cab. Only 15 % of them are Blue.
captions.ask: Before anything is counted: the witness says Blue. What is the chance it was?
captions.commit: Pause and guess. Hold your number; the film will count it out.
captions.in.steelman: The obvious answer, fairly put: she is right 80 % of the time.
captions.in.run-wrong: Run that model and it says 80 %, with confidence.
captions.in.break: But it never looked at the city: 850 of the 1,000 cabs are Green.
captions.in.break-hold: The witness is the same. The question is which cabs she could be describing.
captions.in.r.close: Test her on every cab. 120 Blue and 170 Green cabs would be called Blue.
captions.in.r.reseat: Only those 290 are still in question. The rest stay, faint, on the page.
captions.in.r.count: Count the Blue ones among them: 120 of 290. About 41 %, not 80 %.
captions.gap: Most of us land near 80. The count says 41: a gap of about 40 points.
captions.in.r.hold: Most cabs she would call Blue are Green: there are so many more of them.
captions.in.r.name: The base rate decides: the evidence only picks the denominator.
captions.in.fruitful: The count also answers a fresh case: if she said Green, 680 of 710, 96 %.

captions.clone: Split the city in two. Keep the witness exactly the same.

captions.a.hold: Same witness, same 80 %, very different answers.
captions.a.name: In each city, the denominator is the cabs she would call Blue.

captions.differ: What differs: only the base rate. 41 % in one city, 80 % in the other.
captions.name: 80 % is the right answer only in a city that is half Blue. That is the neglect.
